name: Student Information System (SIS)
description: Central database containing grades, home addresses, medical alerts, and parent contacts.
treatment: Mitigate (MFA, database encryption, strict role-based access control)

name: Classroom Interactive Smartboards
description: Displays in classrooms used by teachers during instruction.
treatment: Accept / Mitigate (Standard warranty and spare units)

name: Emergency Public Address & Lockdown System
description: Campus-wide loudspeaker and automated door lockdown controller.
threat: Power failure or network disruption during an emergency
treatment: Mitigate (Uninterruptible power supply, separate offline wiring)

name: Cafeteria Point of Sale (POS) Terminals
description: Payment card readers and lunch account balance terminals.
threat: Credit card skimming or offline network drop during lunch
treatment: Transfer / Mitigate (PCI-DSS compliance, encrypted card readers)
